aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Left unset, the output keeps the ratio of the person image.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

instruction.description: Optional. A complete try-on instruction already runs; this is appended to it. Use it to say what layers over what, or which items stay untouched.
instruction.title: Instruction

garment_image_urls.title: Garment Image Urls
garment_image_urls.description: One to three garment or accessory images. They are worn together and layered, each replacing the corresponding item the person currently wears. Fabric, color, texture, pattern and print placement, closures and proportions are reproduced as given.

seed.description: Random seed. The same seed with the same inputs returns the same image.
seed.title: Seed

sync_mode.description: Return the image inline in the response instead of as a hosted URL. Adds latency.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

person_image_url.description: Photo of the person who will wear the garments. Their identity, face, hair, body shape, pose and the background are preserved.
person_image_url.title: Person Image Url

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.
